scope: Pinned Swift external-scanner protocol evidence. Fourteen independent positive full trees are exact assertions; five recovered/refused TS trees remain raw evidence. The comment/directive difference is explicitly classified, never normalized into a tree match. No upstream grammar is vendored.

notes: We admit Swift’s empty tuple value through the existing tuple expression; upstream requires an element and rejects compiler-valid () and .success(()).
We keep try and nested await expressions inside a for collection, preserving their expr fields; the pinned grammar consumes the loop body as a trailing closure after a throwing array.
